sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
In Escape from Tarkov, transits are used for map to map travel without leaving a raid.

Transits are available 1 minute after the start of a raid and have a 20 second timer. Once a transit has been activated, extractions can no longer be used. All players of a lobby-made group need to be in the transit area for a transition to succeed, otherwise the timer restarts.

The available transits on each location can be found here:
- Ground Zero
- Streets of Tarkov
- Interchange
- Customs
- Factory
- Woods
- Reserve
- Lighthouse
- Shoreline
- The Lab

sections.heading: Item delivery
sections.text:
When using a transit as PMC, players can send items to their stash for a fee. Items will arrive after 1 hour via the mail system.

The size of the delivery inventory is influenced by your Scav karma.
| Scav karma | Inventory size |
| -0.99 - 0.99 | 3x4 |
| 1 - 2.99 | 4x4 |
| 3 - 4.99 | 4x5 |
| 5+ | 5x5 |

sections.heading: EXP multiplier
sections.text:
When transits are used in the PvP game mode, a multiplier is applied to the EXP for each consecutive location. The below multipliers are not applied to the total raid EXP.

| Transit location no. | EXP multiplier |
| 1 | 1.16× |
| 2 | 1.34× |
| 3 | 1.56× |
| 4 | 1.8× |
| 5 | 2.09× |
| 6 | 2.42× |
| 7 | 2.81× |
| 8 | 3.26× |
| 9 | 3.77× |
| 10 | 4.37× |
| 11 | 5.07× |
| 12 | 5.87× |
| 13 | 6.81× |
| 14 | 7.89× |
| 15 | 9.15× |
| 16 | 10.6× |
